product: Fast Media Sorter for Wear OS
scope: One row per navigation route of the watch app (composable destinations under wear/src/main/java). Dialogs and menus inside a screen are not surfaces, and tiles and complications belong to the system, so none of them has a row. Every row is form none (S4291): a round screen has no top-right corner and no F1, and CONTEXT-HELP rule 4 is met by a reasoned none. The file stays outside src/main because nothing on the watch reads it.

surfaces.name: Home
surfaces.reason: A short list of section entries, each named by its own label; a round screen has no corner for a help action and no keyboard for F1.

surfaces.name: Local
surfaces.reason: A list of media categories on the watch, each row named by what it opens.

surfaces.name: Phone
surfaces.reason: A list of the phone's media categories, each row named by what it opens.

surfaces.name: Favorites
surfaces.reason: A plain list of the files the user marked; the list is its own explanation.

surfaces.name: Streams
surfaces.reason: A scrolling list of streams with labelled search, filter and sort entries; a tap on a row plays it.

surfaces.name: Programs
surfaces.reason: A launcher list of the watch's mini-programs; every row is the program's name.

surfaces.name: Resources
surfaces.reason: A list of the network resources synced from the phone, each row named by the resource.

surfaces.name: Phone
surfaces.reason: A list of the phone's folders one level at a time; the rows are the folder names.

surfaces.name: Add resource
surfaces.reason: A short form whose fields carry their own labels; the phone's help page covers adding a resource.

surfaces.name: Add resource
surfaces.reason: An older address of the same form as the add-resource screen, kept reachable for a stale back stack.

surfaces.name: Sync from Phone
surfaces.reason: A progress-only screen: one status line while the phone sends data, then it leaves for the result.

surfaces.name: Sync Complete
surfaces.reason: A result line with the counts and one Browse button; the text is the whole explanation.

surfaces.name: Browse
surfaces.reason: A file list of one media type on the watch; a row opens the file and a long press opens its actions.

surfaces.name: Browse
surfaces.reason: The same file list for one network resource; it behaves exactly like the watch's own browse list.

surfaces.name: Browse
surfaces.reason: The same file list for the phone's media; it behaves exactly like the watch's own browse list.

surfaces.name: Folders
surfaces.reason: One level of a folder walk; the rows are the folder and file names.

surfaces.name: Media type
surfaces.reason: A choice between media types for the resource just picked; each row is the type's name.

surfaces.name: Select Resource
surfaces.reason: A one-question picker opened from the tile settings; its title says what is being chosen.

surfaces.name: Audio player
surfaces.reason: A full-screen player whose controls are the standard transport symbols; the screen is the content.

surfaces.name: Video player
surfaces.reason: A full-screen player that gives the whole round face to the picture; the screen is the content.

surfaces.name: Image viewer
surfaces.reason: A full-screen picture with swipe and pinch; the screen is the content.

surfaces.name: Document viewer
surfaces.reason: A full-screen page of a document the watch renders; the screen is the content.

surfaces.name: Cannot open here
surfaces.reason: A refusal message that names the format; its text is the whole explanation.

surfaces.name: Container credential
surfaces.reason: A one-field credential entry whose title names the errand: encrypt, decrypt or open.

surfaces.name: Settings
surfaces.reason: A list of settings groups, each row labelled; the phone's settings help covers what they mean.

surfaces.name: Media Types
surfaces.reason: A list of switches, one per media type, each with its own label.

surfaces.name: Slideshow
surfaces.reason: A switch and an interval stepper, each with its own label.

surfaces.name: Screen
surfaces.reason: A short list of display switches, each with its own label.

surfaces.name: Other
surfaces.reason: A short list of switches and entries, each with its own label.

surfaces.name: Tile Targets
surfaces.reason: A list of tile slots; each row names the target it holds and opens the picker.

surfaces.name: Permissions
surfaces.reason: A list of permission groups with their state; each row is labelled, and the system dialog explains the grant.

surfaces.name: Exchange servers
surfaces.reason: A list of the exchange servers the phone synced; each row is the server's name.

surfaces.name: Broadcasts
surfaces.reason: A list of the broadcasts of one account; each row is the broadcast's title.

surfaces.name: Account folders
surfaces.reason: A list of the folders one account offers; each row is the folder's name.

surfaces.name: About
surfaces.reason: Version information with one send-logs button and one portal link; both are labelled.

surfaces.name: Calculator
surfaces.reason: A keypad whose keys are their own labels; holding the menu key leaves.

surfaces.name: Stopwatch
surfaces.reason: One time readout with start, lap and reset controls; holding the menu control leaves.

surfaces.name: Mini-game
surfaces.reason: A game board; its rules have a screen of their own.

surfaces.name: Rules
surfaces.reason: It is itself help: the rules and the legend of the mini-game.

surfaces.name: Water flashlight
surfaces.reason: The display used as a light with touch locked; there is nothing on it to explain and it leaves by its own gesture.

surfaces.name: SOS
surfaces.reason: A distress signal screen that must stay uncluttered; it leaves by its own gesture.

surfaces.name: Voice recorder
surfaces.reason: One record and stop control with a status line that says what is happening.

surfaces.name: Voice notes
surfaces.reason: A list of recorded notes, each row showing its state: kept, waiting, sent or not sent.

surfaces.name: System information
surfaces.reason: A read-only report in labelled sections: device, app, memory, storage and phone.

surfaces.name: Clipboard
surfaces.reason: The watch's clipboard text with a labelled send action.

surfaces.name: Activity & Analytics
surfaces.reason: Live readings, each with its own label, and a history entry.

surfaces.name: Activity history
surfaces.reason: A read-only history of activity measurements with a trend; the labels are the explanation.

surfaces.name: Heart rate check
surfaces.reason: A single measurement screen with a start control and a history entry; the readout is labelled.

surfaces.name: Heart rate history
surfaces.reason: A read-only history of pulse measurements with a trend; the labels are the explanation.

surfaces.name: Blood pressure
surfaces.reason: A single estimate screen with a start control, a calibration entry and a history entry; the readout is labelled.

surfaces.name: Calibration
surfaces.reason: A short entry form for a cuff reading and a list of saved pairs; every field is labelled.

surfaces.name: History
surfaces.reason: A read-only history of blood pressure estimates with a trend; the labels are the explanation.

surfaces.name: Broadcast
surfaces.reason: One start and stop control with a status line and a QR entry; the status says what is happening.

surfaces.name: Broadcast QR code
surfaces.reason: A scannable code on its own; there is room for nothing else on the round face.

surfaces.name: Phone camera
surfaces.reason: One start control and a status line for a view of the paired phone's camera.

surfaces.name: Network Monitor
surfaces.reason: A list of monitor sections, each row named by what it shows.

surfaces.name: Network Monitor section
surfaces.reason: A read-only section of the monitor with labelled readings.

surfaces.name: Tourist
surfaces.reason: A dashboard of labelled readings and tiles; each tile is named by what it shows.

surfaces.name: Counter
surfaces.reason: One counter with plus, minus and reset controls.
